title: The Private Famous Coronado Tour
includes: Food and drinks, unless specified (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children 2 years and under are free
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
policies: It is recommended that you wear comfortable walking shoes
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the affluent beach resort town of Coronado with a private guide, departing for the island by luxury vehicle from your San Diego hotel. You’ll spend two hours on a private tour that includes an extensive visit to the iconic Hotel del Coronado, Coronado Beach and the Glorietta Bay Inn, plus stop for photos of the city skyline across San Diego Bay.
